title: LintProfile missing on 5 of 7 RFC-baseline profiles
description: pkix-profiles defines 7 RFC-baseline Profile types. Only 2 (BasicTlsProfile, BasicSmimeProfile) have LintProfile impls. The other 5 (Rfc5280Profile, BasicTlsClientProfile, BasicCodeSigningProfile, BasicTimeStampingProfile, BasicOcspResponderProfile) do not, so they cannot participate in pkix_lint::check_shape() or shape-check convenience aliases. In contrast, pkix-profiles-cabf achieves 7-for-7 LintProfile coverage across its Profile types. This asymmetry means callers using BasicCodeSigningProfile or BasicTimeStampingProfile cannot call check_shape(), while callers using BasicTlsProfile can. If applicable RFC-conformance lints exist (e.g. signatureAlgorithm match, serial-number length cap), they should be bundled. Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs.
